notes.title: Multiple Endings Patch
notes.content: [p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Multiple Endings Change[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]NOTE[/b][/p][p]The way multiple endings are determined has been changed. Only bad choices will affect your ending; good choices no longer increase chances of getting a better ending which would be why people would get the same ending every time.[/p][p]I have also seen a question about what gender the main character you play as is. The character you play as is whatever you want them to be. The character is not tied to any gender or name; you are what you want to be.[/p][p][/p][p]I also am aware of issues or lack of features or story quality. I am a solo dev, so I apologize. I however am determined to improve this game to be what people want, that is why I have decided to go through a complete overhaul of everything from Graphics, Story, Mechanics & Features. [/p][p][/p][p]I am excited to begin,[/p][p]Thank you![/p]

notes.title: Achievements Patch & Internal Rework
notes.content:
Hello!,

I can safely say now that the achievement bug has been officially resolved FINALLY!
The cause of this bug was found to be linked to the Skip button. When players would skip a conversation, it would completely break the games connection to the steam servers, preventing any achievements from unlocking further on. This explains why some players could unlock achievements without issues.

I apologize for this bug not being fixed sooner. 

P.S 
(I am also looking into the multiple endings not changing apparently & hope to rework it to work correctly)

Thanks!

notes.title: Dev Log #5
notes.content:
Hello! Sorry for the late dev log, this log will be fairly short. Got some news about the upcoming Aftermath Update! 

[b]Aftermath Update Contents[/b]
The Aftermath Update will bring new features, bug fixes & improvements. Listed below are the contents that are coming in the update.
[list]
[*] New side story (Fame: Aftermath)
[*] New Game Plus (Story mode only)
[*] 6 more snap slots
[*] Achievement fixes
[*] General Bug Fixes
[/list]

[b]Fame: Aftermath Side Story[/b]
The first side story will focus on the events after the main story (based off true ending). The side stories are short & will be about 30mins long. If the story contains spoilers for the main story, it will have a tag next to it displaying *Spoilers*.

[b] New Game Plus[/b]
Finally new game plus! Players will have 3 slots for different save files. Please note that when the update drops it may reset your story progress. This feature is also only for story mode, side stories do not have new game plus access.

[b]Achievements[/b]
Achievements seem to only pop on some profiles. Fixes are actively being implemented to solve this issue, but it is hard to track this problem. However, I will continue to combat this bug!

[b]Update Release Date[/b]
The Aftermath Update has no exact release date at this time but expect it to be before December ends. There may be a chance the update gets delayed till Jan 2025. If this happens, I will let you know in Dev Log #6. 

Thank you!
-Palm Tree

notes.title: Dev Log #4
notes.content:
Hello! after the release of the quality-of-life update, dev log #4 is here to go over future plans for the next update to come.

[b]Overview[/b]
The next big update will focus on side stories! The first side story will be free & will not require any additional download.  Hopefully the new game plus feature can also be implemented alongside this update with general bug fixes included.

[b]Upcoming Patch[/b]
Before the next big update, a small minor patch will release fixing a few bugs. The bugs known are listed below & are being worked on.
[list]
[*] Achievements Not Unlocking Correctly.
[*] 18+ Content Filter Sometimes Doesn't block/allow content.
[*] Music May Sometimes Randomly Stop Playing.
[/list]

These are the major known bugs that are currently being prioritized. If any more major issues are found, they will be addressed in the same patch.

[b]Mac Support[/b]
Fame will also be coming to Mac! The Mac port will be updated alongside the normal windows version. No current release date is in mind but work on the port has started. Most likely the Mac version will not release before the next big update, future dev logs will have details regarding the Mac version if anything changes.


[b]The Next Big Update[/b] 
The next major update is expected to release sometime next month. This update like mentioned before will be focused on a new side story. Here listed are the contents that will be present in the major update in December:

[list]
[*] 1 New Side Story (Free)
[*] New Game Plus (Subject to Change.)
[*] Preference Menu (Adjust Dialogue Speed, Colors, etc.)
[*] Language Settings (Subject to Change.)
[*] Improved 18+ Filter.
[*] Music Fixes.
[*] Music Player.
[*] Menu Enhancements.
[*] Character Art Improvements.
[*] 6 More Snaps Slots (12 In Total.) 
[/list]

[b]Conclusion[/b]
Like always more dev logs will be posted to keep everyone updated on what's happening behind the scenes. Communication is key & always will be the most important thing. Hope you enjoy!

-Palm Tree & Tropical Games.

notes.title: Dev Log #2
notes.content:
Hello! This is a sneak-peak at the upcoming quality of life update to Fame. Features listed in the previous dev log are still coming to the game as planned but some systems or updates have been moved around.
The art-overhaul will instead come alongside the snaps & new game plus features instead of later in December like originally planned. The update is expected to come shortly before the end of the month.

[b]What is Coming? [/b]
The update will bring the following:
[list]
[*] Art Style Overhaul (Palm Tree Games Style)
[*] Snaps System (Fames version of a gallery)
[*] New Game Plus (3 New Game Slots Can Be Made.)
[*] Interface Changes & Animations for some UI.
[*] Bug fixes & improvements.
[*] Patch Notes Can Be Accessed Through Menus.
[*] News or Upcoming Events will be displayed on Menus.
[*] Bug report + Feature Wishlist
[/list]

[b]Palm Tree Involvement[/b]
As stated in the last dev log, Palm Tree Games is a sub studio under Tropical Games that is used for smaller projects. Palm Tree is now in charge of updates & fixes to Fame.

[b]Store Page Changes[/b]
When the update drops the Store Page will go through changes replacing the Images & Artwork to the Palm Tree Style (New Art Overhaul), removing the legacy art. 

[b]What Is Next? [/b]
After the quality-of-life update has released, work will begin on the first Fame Side Story. The first side story will be free & will not require any separate download. Other bug fixes will also be done with the next update alongside new features that may come.

[b] Dev Logs [/b]
Dev Logs are a great way to update everyone on how the game is going in between updates. Players or people interested will not be left in radio silence, wondering if the game is still being worked on or cared for. Communication is a huge factor in creating better experiences. Dev Logs will be released every 2 weeks or weekly. Each Dev Log will provide an insight into what's currently happening during development, a 3rd Dev Log will be released prior to the Quality-of-life update.

Thank you!
- Palm Tree Games

notes.title: Dev Log #1
notes.content:
[b]Dev Log #1[/b]
Dev logs will be used to give insight to upcoming features to Fame & re-works. Fame is set to go through a few quality-of-life changes & I will go over the topics such as:
[list]
[*] Art Overhaul
[*] Snaps Feature
[*] New Game Plus
[/list]

[b]Art Overhaul[/b]
The artwork in the game mainly of characters will be completely redrawn to match other visual novel styles. However, the old art style will still remain as a setting to change between the old & new character sprites. This decision is nothing new, originally the game was suppsoed to contain 2 art styles that could be toggled but was eventually scrapped. The new art style is already in the works & should make the game match other visual novel styles, currently this art overhaul may not make it to the game until later on.

[b]Snaps Feature[/b]
The snaps feature serves as the "Gallery" feature usually present in visual novels. The snaps button will be alongside the interface buttons (Auto, Menu, Quick Save & Skip) upon pressing the Snaps button, an icon will be displayed showing a snap has been done. Snaps will save the current scene you're on & stores it in a list of snaps (6 Snaps Max). You can access your snaps from the main menu, when replaying a snap it will put the game into "Snaps Mode" this will allow you to play from the point the snap was taken without affecting your normal save files.

When in Snaps Mode the game will not auto save & quick save is disabled to avoid conflicts with your saves. You can clear your snaps at any time & make more if you run out of snap slots. The snaps feature currently only supports 6 slots but may soon support up to 12 slots. The feature is complete & will release with the next patch update.

[b]New Game Plus[/b]
The New Game Plus feature should have been in the game at the start but complications were found. A new approach to this feature is being tested & will allow players to have 3 different save files. This feature may not come in the next patch alongside the Snaps, or it might.

[b]Notes From Dev[/b]
More information about the next patch will be shared in Dev Log #2. Also, you may have noticed a price change with Fame. Fames price will remain at what it is at the moment & will not be changing. If you purchased at its original price I apologize for the sudden change in price. I was unsure of what the price should have been at the time but after talking with others I came to the conclusion to lower it to a more appropriate price.

A new sub studio of Tropical Games, "Palm Tree Games" will be joining alongside Fames Devlopment & future games developments with some other projects lead by Palm Tree. 

Thank you!
- TG

notes.title: WELCOME TO FAME
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45083537/7d34ec0791498ece491740b9310745f9561b4c76.png[/img]

[h1] Welcome to the Fame Demo![/h1]
Hello! I am the lead dev for Tropicalgames, I am excited to share my creations & take you through what you can expect in FAME. The demo includes only a small portion of what the game has to offer in the full release of Fame, but has many secrets waiting to be uncovered.

[h1]What Is Fame About?[/h1]

Fame is about a group of hotel guests that were each invited personally by the hotels owner Mr. Sasha Manson, after taking the guests through daily activities the story takes a dark turn. Murders begin to happen to each guest one by one, leading a detective to investigate the murders at the hotel. However, you are in a race against the clock. You have been placed as the number 1 suspect in the investigation. You will need to conduct your own investigation to find the true killer before you are framed. The actions you choose will determine your outcome so be careful.

[h1]What Content Will Fame Have?[/h1]

Fame will offer an estimated 7–8-hour long story (Considering You read at normal pace) & will have choice matters gameplay that will determine the ending you get in the end. The game will have up to 7 endings that you can get, adding a lot of replay for the main story.

Fame is also planned to have short side stories that will feature characters from the main story or entirely new faces with their own story. The side stories will be shorter than the main story with an estimated runtime of 1hr. The side stories will release over the course of Fames life

[h1]What Features Are Coming?[/h1]

[list]
[*] Choice Matters Gameplay
[*] 7 Endings
[*] 18+ Content Filter (To Block Unwanted Nudity Scenes)
[*] Snap Feature (Allows you to snap a scene & replay it from wherever you started the snap.)
[*] Realistic Character Personalities  
[/list]

Fame may also have some different features that will allow users to create & share their own side stories. (This feature is not confirmed)

I hope you enjoy what is in store for you all! 

-Tropicalgames
